description: Diagnostic category registry for the Cursus Honorum question bank. Each diagnostic question carries one `category` tag from this list so per-category accuracy can be tracked. The AlphaZero difficulty router reads `category` + `elo_weight` to pick the next item: after calibration locates a ballpark Elo, diagnostic sampling widens where per-category accuracy is HIGH and narrows/re-tests where it DROPS.

tenets.T3: Systems Must Know When They Are Unreliable
tenets.T4: Premature Complexity Kills More Systems Than Lack of Edge

categories.carry_direction: Which way to trade a pair given the rate differential; long the high-yield BASE / short the high-yield QUOTE; the 100bp floor.
categories.carry_mechanics: How the carry floor is built and sized: 0.3%/pair, 3xATR stops, separate ledger, the coupon-not-signal framing.
categories.cot_interpretation: Reading CFTC Commitment-of-Traders positioning: extremes are contrarian, the Tue-measured/Fri-published look-ahead rule, JPY inverse to USDJPY.
categories.regime_id: Classifying the current market regime (RISK_ON / RISK_OFF / EXTREME_RISK_OFF / NEUTRAL) from VIX + term structure, and rate-trending vs range.
categories.confirmation_protocol: The combat vetoes and gates a signal must clear before it trades (MACRO_AGAINST, RATE_SIGNAL_WEAK, min score/grade, right-to-abstain).
categories.sizing_conviction: Turning a conviction score / grade into a position size, and where the RISK_CONSTITUTION cap overrides the grade table.
categories.tail_risk_fomc: Behaviour around scheduled macro shocks (FOMC/CPI/RBA) and violent carry unwinds; VIX-extreme and backwardation handling.
categories.tenet_mapping: Mapping a decision or component back to which of the six tenets justifies it.
categories.isolation_discipline: The ICT<->Sovereign time-horizon wall; no feature sharing; the two legal cross-system channels; the 0.15 IC bar.
categories.petroulas_conviction: The dual-confirmation Petroulas gate for conviction-sized (3-5%) structural-fault trades; arithmetic proof over narrative.
categories.risk_constitution: The hard capital-preservation laws: 0.75% per-trade, 2.5% carry heat, 3.5/5/6.5 breaker ladder, no-override, unproven-edge gate.
categories.state_vector: The locked 8-dimension state vector S(t) and what each dimension means.
categories.ict_reference: ICT as an unproven (p=0.52) TP/SL reference layer, NOT a predictive edge; its scoring/gates and anti-edge components.
categories.evidence_epistemics: What is actually proven vs assumed: carry real-but-regime-fragile, ICT not proven, promotion gates, the graveyard.
categories.graveyard_discipline: Not reviving buried features/hypotheses without new evidence (new hypothesis + N>=200 fresh trades + logged sign-off).
